title: Cosmo installs Flows behind its Yes card (no engine install)
description:
Fabio 2026-10-13: Cosmo may install a Flow, never the engine. Today Cosmo's install_model refuses a Flow with IS_A_FLOW (services/agentLoop.mjs) and sends the user to the Flow Library.

Give Cosmo an install for Flows behind the same Yes / No confirm card install_model uses (title + size + the licence-screen note), reusing the MPI-1126 pieces: agent.install-flow in js/shell/agentDispatch.js (size-only without start), POST /connector/install-flow, agentTools.installFlow, js/services/flowInstall.js. Either widen install_model to accept a Flow id or add install_flow; pick the one that keeps the prompt shortest. NO_ENGINE: say so and point at Settings > Remote or the app's own engine install; Cosmo never installs the engine.

Also fix Cosmo's guide: on 2026-10-13 it told Fabio the Song Flow (minimax-music) is a paid 'Get it' Flow. It is free (13.4 GB, licence screen). Only Head Swap and DramaBox are paid.

Files held by the 'Cosmo's prompt budget 1' session (MPI-1125) at filing time: agentLoop.mjs, docs/agent/, MpiAgentChat. Start after it releases them.
